items.title: Recreation and Park Department cover letter and/or report
Report or correspondence from other Department or Agency
Discussion and possible action to approve the minutes from November 19, 2020
SAN FRANCISCO ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY ANIMAL TRANSACTIONS approve the following animal transactions for the San Francisco Zoological Society which were processed under Resolution No. 13572
MCLAREN PARK PCA GRANT – Authorize the General Manager to enter into an agreement with the San Francisco Metropolitan Transportation Commission concerning the administration of a $194,000
FY20-21 DEFERRED MAINTENANCE FUNDING approve the allocation of $1,042,800 from the Open Space Fund Contingency Reserve to fund infrastructure deferred maintenance projects

SAN FRANCISCO ZOO – ADMISSIONS FEE INCREASE Discussion and possible action to approve a request by the San Francisco Zoological Society to increase the admission fees at the San Francisco Zoo and Gardens

COVID-19 ADJUSTMENTS TO LEASES AND CONCESSIONS Authorize the General Manager to modify existing leases, concession agreements, and operating agreements in light of tenant financial hardships caused by the COVID-19 pandemic
900 INNES AVENUE (INDIA BASIN) – Possible action to award a construction contract to Rubecon Builders in an amount not to exceed $7,099,700 for the 900 Innes Remediation Contract No. 1000016646
RACIAL EQUITY ACTION PLAN Discussion only of the Department’s draft Racial Equity Action Plan, as required by the new Office of Racial Equity
